latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of A2E AI Image to Video.

- Convert static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) to animated 1080p video clips (MP4).
- Simple workflow: upload image, describe desired animation, and receive downloadable video in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic backend connection and credential management; 100 free credits with anonymous token (valid 7 days).
- Supports editing workflows: status, credits check, timeline summary, and export.
- Error handling and clear user guidance for common cases (token, credits, file limits).
- Designed for fast, no-hassle content creation for social media and marketing.
